record: R118_F31A_SCORING_AMENDMENT_1/1.0.1 (Art. 4 additive amendment, PRE-CLAIM — filed BEFORE any F31a result is pushed or claimed)
the_finding: the prereg named 'the committed F30 detectors' as the bill-level defect detectors — WRONG TOOL: the F30 detectors are PROBLEM-bytes detectors (they scan the embedded draft inside prob['question']; on the authoring set's question bytes there is no draft, so every class reads clean — 0/24 on both arms, a degenerate measurement, caught BEFORE any result was claimed: the scoring.json written at 15:25Z is a DEGENERATE-NULL record, superseded by this amendment). The only committed, adjudicated definitions of the 6 defect classes ON BILLS are the machine's own bind scans (scan_input_availability, scan_duty_cycle_pricing, scan_allowed_measures_class/CONSTRAINT_EXCLUSION, scan_physics_direction/PHYSICS_DIRECTION_INVERTED, the magnitude/physics registry legs) — the same scans the binds arm's check layer ran.

the_amendment.bill_defect_detector: the machine's own bind scans over (prob, delivered_bill) — the class->scan map: input_availability=INPUT_UNAVAILABLE; duty_pricing=UNPRICED_DUTY_CYCLE; constraint_violation/measurement_not_allowed=CONSTRAINT_EXCLUSION or ALLOWED_ROW_OUTSIDE; physics_direction_inversion=PHYSICS_DIRECTION_INVERTED; magnitude_bound_violation=the physics-registry magnitude legs (PHYSICS_DIRECTION_UNSTATED does NOT count — 'unstated' is a formatting demand, not a defect class). A bill is DEFECTIVE iff any mapped scan fires on the DELIVERED bill
the_amendment.the_circularity_caveat_DISCLOSED: the binds arm's repair loop optimized against exactly these scans, so the comparison measures (bare bills as-authored) vs (binds-repaired bills) under the same scans — a convergence-flavored read. This is the honest form available: the classes' only committed definitions ARE the binds. The auditor reads the caveat; the acceptance branch is UNCHANGED (CI excludes 0 with binds lower AND damage gate <= 0.25 -> PROVEN; else TYPED_NEGATIVE with the caveat)
the_amendment.damage_gate_unchanged: among clean-bare items, the fraction where the binds arm's delivered bill carries a class the bare bill lacked — <= 0.25
the_amendment.everything_else_unchanged: the set, arms, bootstrap (seed 118), gates, zero-LLM discipline

invalidates: the 15:25Z degenerate scoring.json only (never pushed, never claimed); the prereg's detector clause is superseded by this amendment; the run bytes (both arms, 48 committed generations) are UNTOUCHED
